😨 Bitcoin's "fear gauge" hit 5 out of 100 this year, its lowest reading ever recorded.

On 6 February 2026, the Crypto Fear & Greed Index dropped to 5. By early November it was back at 34: still fear, but not panic.

The gauge measures mood (price swings, trading volume, momentum and social media buzz), not the future. It's one of 10 signals analysts watch to judge whether Bitcoin has hit bottom.

▶️ Watch all 10 signals in the full video on our YouTube channel (link in bio): https://youtu.be/VHEALYRKMx0

Crypto prices can swing sharply both ways. Education, not financial advice.
